train_superkmeans_with_parameters: train a SuperKMeans model with custom seed, niter, and y_batch parameters on synthetic dataset
test_superkmeans_objective_monotonicity: test that SuperKMeans objective decreases monotonically across training iterations using iteration_stats
compare_superkmeans_to_vanilla_kmeans: compare SuperKMeans final objective against vanilla faiss Kmeans to verify results are within 5 percent
check_gemm_pruning_rates: check the GEMM pruning rates per iteration after training a SuperKMeans model on synthetic data
assign_vectors_with_superkmeans: assign vectors to nearest centroids using the SuperKmeans wrapper assign method and verify cluster indices
